job: Produce one bounded workflow handoff result from exact supplied evidence.
sideEffects: create mission-only checkpoint commits on dedicated branches only when the routed Git policy permits them
under direct-main policy fetch incoming branch refs and merge them non-force into the declared mutation branch without creating or switching branches
push approved heads and one annotated continuation tag without force
fetch and adopt exact checkpoint heads in resume mode only after identity, policy, and cleanliness proof
stopConditions: an exact reference is missing or its fingerprint differs
the requested branch action violates the routed Git mutation policy
the requested work exceeds this operator job
